text:
Maya: Heads-up — publishing a short how-to for packaging cross-functional evidence for this review cycle. Quick checklist + filename examples below. Please follow these so calibration has consistent context. :spiral_calendar:

Alex: Thanks Maya — is this for ICs only or should managers add their annotated notes too?

Maya: Both. Employees upload raw artifacts, managers add a 1-2 sentence annotation/rationale per competency. Artifacts should be concrete (PRs, RFCs, postmortems, dashboards, demo recordings). Keep it short. :thumbsup:

Jordan: If the work was paired with PMs/product designers, do we include PM writeups or just engineering artifacts?

Maya: Include partner artifacts if they add context (e.g., PM brief, scope doc). If sensitive, redact names as needed. The idea is to show impact and scope, not reproduce full chat threads.

Sam: Upload location: Performance > Evidence Upload in the Console (link: https://console.redwood.ai/performance/evidence). Please set permissions to team-visible only. Deadline: evidence window closes in 72 hours from this message. Managers should annotate by the end of the following week.

Alex: Any required format? CSV/markdown/links?

Maya: No heavyweight format. Preferred: links to artifacts + a short context note. Use the filename pattern below for attachments so reviewers can scan quickly.

```
filename pattern examples:
  <lastname>_<firstname>-<role>-<project>-evidence-2026-03-23.pdf
  smith_sam-engineer-simcache-demo-2026-03-23.mp4
what to include per artifact:
  - 1-line description
  - your role and % contribution
  - link or attachment
  - 1-sentence why it maps to the competency
```

Maya: Minimal expectations: 1–3 artifacts per rated competency, or 3–5 artifacts overall demonstrating breadth/depth. If you only have one big artifact, add a short synthesis note listing observed behaviors.

Jordan: How will peer/partner feedback be handled? Can I paste PM comments into an attachment?

Sam: Partner feedback is fine as attachments but ask for explicit permission if it includes personal notes. For third-party customer feedback, redact company PII. If in doubt, send to me and I’ll advise.

Alex: Quick question on screenshots — fine to blur user emails?

Maya: Yes blur PII/PHI. Compliance will run a light scan and will ping any items that look risky. For compliance questions, cc @sam.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: Evidence upload window closes in 72 hours. Managers, please confirm annotation plans within 48 hours.

Maya: We’ll do a small spot-check sample after the window closes. If evidence is missing or unclear, managers will be asked to follow up. If you hit any edge cases (contractors, cross-org initiatives, embargoed customer work) ping Sam or drop here and we’ll triage. :eyes:
